description: Adds one Toolshed item to this business as its own copy, as Add in Automations > Toolshed does. A shared flow or a Sergio starter lands as a draft (off), with Sergio's autonomy dropped so a person sets who sends; a Scanner is adopted on, watching for you; a handbook job is written into this business's handbook. versionId is the item's id from the Toolshed catalog (GET /api/marketplace/browse): a shared version's uuid, or a Sergio item's sergio:<key>. update: true moves an already-added Scanner to the item's current version. Adding an item already added returns the existing copy (alreadyInstalled). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: install_toolshed_item
title: Add a Toolshed item
